<div class="card-body">
'''Blaster Rifle''' is a [[Light]] [[Weapon]] ([[Character Weapon]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ブラスター・ライフル</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">２フォース消費し、任意の戦士に配備する。２フォース消費して起動する。運命数を引き、キャラクターなら運命数＋１＞能力値で、ビークルなら運命数＋１＞回避値か装甲値で命中する。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-153o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ブラステックＥ－１１ブラスター・ライフル。帝国軍の標準武装。大量に生産されたため、反乱軍にも流出している。銃床は折り畳み式。１００発分のエネルギーを充填。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Blaster Rifle.

'''Card text:''' Use 2 Force to deploy on any warrior. Use 2 Force to fire. Draw destiny. A character is hit if destiny +1 > ability. A vehicle is hit if destiny +1 > maneuver or armor.

'''Lore:''' A BlasTech E-11 blaster rifle. Standard Imperial issue. Produced in such numbers that many have reached the Rebellion. Folding stock. Holds energy for 100 shots.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese spends 2 Force to fire; the English may target using 2 Force.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Blaster Rifle]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
